_comment: Fine ink and fine paper, so a linking book is a mid-tier reward rather than a consumable.
The ink is a BUCKET because ink is a fluid and a crafting ingredient must be an item -- a bucket for
one book is almost certainly too much, and the right unit is a fine ink bottle, which needs the desk
to be able to fill bottles from a tank. Ratio is explicitly unbalanced; the shape is the point.
The empty bucket comes back via the item's craft remainder.
